howItWorks.title: How joymagic Image to Image Works
howItWorks.description: From upload to download in four simple steps.

step1.title: Step 1 – Upload Your Image
step1.description: Start with any clear base image: a product shot, character, logo, UI mockup, or illustration. Drag and drop, or select from your device. joymagic uses this as the reference to keep your subject recognizable.

step2.title: Step 2 – Describe the Change
step2.description:
Add an optional short prompt to guide the AI.

Examples:

  • "turn this into a cozy anime scene at night"
  • "make this look like a high-end studio product photo"
  • "convert this sketch into clean flat illustration"
  • "put this character in a cyberpunk city at sunset"

Short, simple instructions are enough. Or skip the prompt and rely only on style presets.

step3.title: Step 3 – Choose Style & Strength
step3.description:
Tell joymagic how far to go.

  • Select a style preset (realistic, anime, 3D, illustration, etc.)
  • Adjust the Change Strength from light touch-up to full restyle
  • (Optional) Set preferences to keep composition, character, or style consistent

You stay in control of the creative direction—joymagic handles the heavy lifting.

step4.title: Step 4 – Generate & Download
step4.description:
Let the model work, then choose what you like.

  • Generate multiple variations from one input
  • Compare options side by side in the preview
  • Mark your favorites and download them in HD
  • Use them immediately for social, product pages, ads, and presentations

Turn one image into an entire visual set in just a few minutes.

faq.title: FAQs About joymagic Image to Image
faq.description: Common questions about our image to image AI generator.

q1.question: What is an image to image AI generator?
q1.answer: An image to image AI generator takes an existing image and uses it as a reference to create new images. With joymagic, you upload a base image, optionally add a text prompt, choose a style and change strength, and the AI generates new visuals that stay linked to your original subject.

q2.question: Do I need to write a prompt, or can I just upload an image?
q2.answer: You can do both. If you just upload an image and pick a style, joymagic will create variations automatically. If you add a short prompt, you get more control over mood, scene, colors, and details. Prompts are optional — they're there when you want extra precision.

q3.question: Is joymagic free to use? What are the limits?
q3.answer: Yes, joymagic offers a free tier so you can try image to image AI with no commitment. The free tier includes a limited number of generations so you can test workflows and quality. When you're ready to scale, you can upgrade to a paid plan with higher limits and more features. Check the pricing page inside the app for the latest details.

q4.question: Can I use the images commercially?
q4.answer:
In most cases, yes — you can use images generated with joymagic for commercial purposes, including:
  • Client projects
  • Ads and campaigns
  • Product pages and brand content

Two important notes:

  1. Make sure you have the rights to any images you upload as input.
  2. Always review our official Terms of Use and License for the most accurate, up-to-date rules.

The short version: joymagic is designed to be safe for real business use.

q5.question: What image formats and sizes do you support?
q5.answer:
joymagic currently supports popular formats like:
  • JPG
  • PNG
  • WEBP

You can upload standard web and camera resolutions. For outputs, you can choose from:

  • Preset aspect ratios (square, vertical, horizontal, thumbnail, etc.)
  • HD resolutions suitable for web, social, and light print use
  • Optional upscaling for larger banners and presentations

q6.question: Can I keep the same character across multiple images?
q6.answer:
Yes. This is one of the main strengths of image to image with joymagic.
  • Use the same reference image as a base
  • Keep Change Strength moderate and enable options that prioritize the character
  • You can then place that character in different outfits, scenes, and art styles while maintaining recognizable identity

Great for VTubers, story-driven creators, and brands with mascots.

q7.question: Is my uploaded content private and secure?
q7.answer:
joymagic is designed with privacy in mind.
  • Your uploaded images are used to generate your outputs and are not shared with other users
  • We do not use your private projects as public templates
  • Basic security practices are applied to protect your account and assets

For exact details on data handling and retention, please refer to the Privacy Policy and Terms inside the product.
